ads.headline: Why coffee leaves a yellow line on the front teeth
ads.brief: Takeaway coffee cup on a bathroom bench next to the real LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR tube (German pack). Morning light. No teeth or mouths shown. Small supporting tagline beneath: "Brushing twice a day doesn't always shift it."
ads.label: WHITE&REPAIR C1 — Coffee Cup Bench

ads.headline: Do not give up your coffee until you read this.
ads.brief: Cafe chalkboard sign, handwritten chalk lettering, coffee machine blurred behind, showing the headline. Real LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR tube (German pack) photo composited in the bottom corner — do not AI-generate the tube, use the exact reference.
ads.label: WHITE&REPAIR C2 — Cafe Chalkboard Sign

ads.headline: Coffee. Tea. Red wine.
ads.brief: A coffee cup, a cup of tea and a glass of red wine lined up on a kitchen bench, with the real LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR tube (German pack) at the end of the row. Small supporting tagline beneath: "All 3 leave surface stains."
ads.label: WHITE&REPAIR C3 — Flat Lay Drinks

ads.headline: Scrubbing harder hasn't shifted the coffee stains.
ads.brief: A worn-out, splayed old toothbrush lying next to the real LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR tube (German pack) on a clean bench. Small supporting tagline beneath: "Try a gentle polish instead."
ads.label: WHITE&REPAIR C4 — Old Brush vs Tube

ads.headline: Things I've tried: whitening strips / charcoal paste / bleaching pen / coconut oil pulling / the 'brightening' toothpaste
ads.brief: Handwritten list on lined notepad paper titled "Things I've tried", showing the headline items. No crosses or 'doesn't work' marks. Below the list, the real LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR tube (German pack) photo. Small supporting tagline beneath: "1 thing I hadn't: a German toothpaste with no peroxide."
ads.label: WHITE&REPAIR C5 — Tried Everything List

ads.headline: Why some people quit the strips halfway through the box
ads.brief: A bathroom drawer half open. Inside: a half-used box of plain, unbranded whitening strips (no logos, no competitor packs). On the bench above, the real LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR tube (German pack). Small supporting tagline beneath: "No peroxide in this one."
ads.label: WHITE&REPAIR C6 — Drawer Strips

ads.headline: The toothpaste aisle is bloody full of promises.
ads.brief: Blurred supermarket toothpaste aisle in the background (no brand names or packs readable). In the foreground, a hand holding the real LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR tube (German pack). Small supporting tagline beneath: "This one comes off a German pharmacy shelf."
ads.label: WHITE&REPAIR C7 — Supermarket Aisle

ads.headline: Why some coffee drinkers smile with their lips closed in every photo
ads.brief: Clean white card with two big emojis side by side: a closed-mouth smile and a big toothy grin. Headline text above the emojis. Real LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR tube (German pack) photo bottom right. No real people, no teeth photos, no before/after. Small supporting tagline beneath: "It's the colour, not the shape."
ads.label: WHITE&REPAIR C8 — Emoji Smile Contrast

ads.headline: Why some people edit their teeth before posting
ads.brief: Phone screen mock-up of a generic photo-editing app (no real app branding) with a slider labelled "Teeth" being dragged. No face or teeth shown, no before/after. Real LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR tube (German pack) photo beside the phone. Small supporting tagline beneath: "There's an easier way."
ads.label: WHITE&REPAIR C9 — Phone Editing Slider

ads.headline: There are 2 kinds of coffee drinkers.
ads.brief: Two identical coffee cups side by side. Left label: "SMILES WITH TEETH". Right label: "SMILES WITH LIPS CLOSED". Bottom band with the real LACALUT WHITE & REPAIR tube (German pack) photo and the stat line. Small supporting tagline beneath: "1,000,000,000+ LACALUT tubes sold in 60+ countries".
